supportedOperations: Render PDF pages as JPG or PNG at 150 or 300 DPI.
Extract decoded embedded raster images at native dimensions without substituting page renders.
privacyFacts: Files are processed in your browser; this tool does not upload the selected file for processing.
platformRequirements: A modern browser with JavaScript enabled.
Large files depend on available device memory.
limitations: JPG is lossy; PNG uses lossless pixel encoding. Output is rasterized, not editable PDF text, and cannot recover missing source detail.

Extraction excludes vector drawings and standalone stencil masks and does not preserve page layout, clipping or placement. Decoded images are re-encoded, not copied byte-for-byte. No silent page-render fallback.

Each image is limited to 24 million pixels and 16384 pixels per side; total encoded output is limited to 256 MB. Oversized jobs fail explicitly instead of silently downscaling. Password-protected PDFs need an authorized unlocked copy.
facts: Render PDF pages as JPG or PNG at 150 or 300 DPI.
Extract decoded embedded raster images at native dimensions without substituting page renders.
howToSteps: Select your PDFs and choose full pages or embedded images.
Choose JPG or PNG; for full pages choose 150 or 300 DPI (300 DPI is the default).
Export, download and inspect the images. Multiple images are bundled in a ZIP.
